_comment: Symbol aliases for the market fallbacks. Omit an entry to use the built-in default.
_twelvedata_note: Only plain US ETF/stock tickers resolve to the intended instrument on the free 'Community' tier (XLK/XLF/XLE/KWEB verified 2026-11-24). Index/rate/fx/commodity series (^GSPC, ^TNX, GC=F, DX-Y.NYB, CL=F, ...) are not on the Community tier; do NOT alias them to short letters — 'WTI' and 'DX' are stock tickers and silently return unrelated equity data. Unaliased symbols keep their last known values until a working Yahoo proxy is available.
